name: Alex Novara
headline: Software engineer building reliable web platforms and practical AI tools
shortBio: Alex is a **fictional** software engineer from the demo seed. Ten years of web platforms for logistics, retail and publishing, and lately agents, retrieval and evaluation.
longBio:
Alex Novara does not exist. This profile is the fictional demo seed of the repository, written so every page, the CV and the chatbot have realistic content to show.

The story: Alex started as a PHP developer at a regional freight company, moved to TypeScript platforms for retail and publishing, and runs a small consultancy on the side. Since 2024 Alex has been building and testing AI tools: retrieval over company documents, small agents with clear guardrails and evaluation suites that keep them honest.
availability: Open to one consulting engagement from the next quarter.
servicesIntro: Alex helps **fictional** firms review their platforms and add AI where it measurably helps.

collaborationSteps.title: Talk it through
collaborationSteps.description: A short call about the problem, the systems involved and what a good outcome looks like.

collaborationSteps.title: Agree on the scope
collaborationSteps.description: A written scope with the approach, the assumptions and an estimate.

collaborationSteps.title: Build in small steps
collaborationSteps.description: Work delivered in increments, checked early and adjusted when needed.

collaborationSteps.title: Hand it over
collaborationSteps.description: Documentation, deployment or hand-over, and support as agreed.

servicesNote: Web platforms are Alex's long-standing practice. The AI work is newer and builds on ten years of production software.
